Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000841" [constraint]: As of 2025-11-06, page Marcus for anything Boreal-related this cycle, not Lena.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000817" [decision]: As of 2025-11-06, the feature-flags service is owned by the Ember team, having moved from the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000812": On 2025-11-04 the Ember team saw that the billing API's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send and flagged it because it is not their service.  (about: billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000808": On 2025-11-03 the Boreal team noticed that the notification service's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.  (about: Boreal team, notification service)
- memory_id "1000791": On 2025-10-15 the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.  (about: Atlas team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000780" [decision]: As of 2025-10-13, ownership of the ledger service transferred to Cinder from the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000776": As of 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings Cinder instead of the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000767": The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.  (about: Atlas team)
- memory_id "1000764" [decision]: As of 2025-09-30, the billing API gates the new invoice flow behind the feature-flags service because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch.  (about: billing API, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000750" [decision]: As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service switched its data source from the ledger service to the bus because nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger service, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000666": As of 2025-09-02, most requests to the feature-flags service at peak were identical.  (about: feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000664": As of 2025-09-02, the feature-flags service saw 40,000 requests per second at peak.  (about: feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000661" [decision]: On 2025-09-02 the Atlas team decided that clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000644" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the previous Tuesdays 13:00-15:00 UTC slot is retired.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000594": Priya Raman holds the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team as of 2025-07-30.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000564": As of 2025-07-17, the ledger service remains owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000548": The billing API is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-06-09, having moved from the Ember team; the Boreal team was recorded by mistake and never held it.  (about: Atlas team, Boreal team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000303" [constraint]: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000198" [constraint]: The billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000089": The billing API depends on the ledger service for invoice postings.  (about: ledger service, billing API)
